title: Rug Pull Warning
description: Rug pullers, the top killer at 27.9% of deaths, flash a red line along their dash path 0.4 s before they go, so you can sidestep.

title: Level-Up Meter
description: A fat XP bar across the top of the screen that counts down "3 CANDLES TO LEVEL UP" and glows when one candle is left.

title: Relief Rally
description: Once a run the chart flips green for 10 s: every candle is worth double, bears move 20% slower and the music swings major.
